judgments.reason: The paper 'Review of the BCI Competition IV' describes the release of high quality neuroscientific data for open access, including the multi-class continuous data challenge which corresponds to the dataset.
judgments.paper_title: Review of the BCI Competition IV

judgments.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS format, which is the format used by this dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: The paper describes EEG-BIDS, a data structure standard for EEG data, which is mentioned as the BIDS version 1.9.0 in the dataset metadata.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
